name: lens-retrieval-expansion
provenance: Lens-authored synthetic cross-application activity, timelines and near-miss questions written 2026-10-26 after the first holdout run; not user data.
policy: Calibration/diagnosis data (split 'expansion'). May be inspected and used for tuning. It is NOT the sealed holdout.
fields: memories: [id, language, app, timestamp, text]; queries: [id, language, type, query, relevant_ids]. Empty relevant_ids = no valid answer. type: cross_app | timeline | mixed | near_miss | unanswerable
